At Valley Septic, we offer professional grease trap cleaning and maintenance services to keep your commercial kitchen running smoothly. Our experienced technicians thoroughly remove accumulated fats, oils, and grease (FOG), preventing clogs and ensuring your plumbing system functions efficiently for years to come.

Learn More

Grease Trap Service

grease Pumping and cleaning

Grease trap maintenance is a crucial procedure for any commercial kitchen or food service establishment. These specialized devices capture fats, oils, and grease before they enter the main plumbing system, preventing costly blockages and environmental issues. Regular cleaning prevents FOG buildup, which can lead to foul odors, slow drains, and potential health code violations. Our on-site service ensures your grease traps operate at peak efficiency, protecting your plumbing and the local sewer system.

1. Initial Inspection:

We begin by examining your grease trap’s exterior and access points, checking for any visible issues or damage.

2. Lid Removal and Safety Check:

Our technicians carefully remove the grease trap lid and ensure the area is safe for cleaning.

3. Waste Removal:

Using specialized equipment, we thoroughly remove all accumulated FOG and solid waste from the trap

4. Interior Cleaning:

We scrub the interior walls, baffles, and components of the grease trap to remove any remaining residue.

5. System Check:

Our team inspects inlet and outlet pipes, ensuring they’re clear and functioning properly.

6. Proper Disposal and Documentation:

We responsibly dispose of the collected waste and provide detailed service documentation for your records.

Grease Trap FAQ

How often should I have my grease trap cleaned?

The frequency depends on your kitchen’s volume and type of food prepared. We typically recommend monthly cleaning for most establishments, but we can assess your specific needs during an on-site visit.

What happens if I neglect my grease trap?

Neglecting your grease trap can lead to foul odors, slow drains, and potential health code violations. It may also result in costly emergency plumbing repairs and fines from local authorities.

Can you handle grease traps of all sizes?

Yes, our team is equipped to service grease traps of all sizes, from small under-sink units to large outdoor interceptors. We’ll tailor our on-site service to your specific equipment

Do you provide emergency grease trap services?

Absolutely. We offer 24/7 emergency services for urgent grease trap issues. Our team will quickly dispatch to your location to resolve any unexpected problems.

How do I prepare for a grease trap cleaning?

Before our arrival, ensure clear access to the grease trap. If possible, reduce kitchen operations during the cleaning process. Our team will handle all aspects of the cleaning on-site, minimizing disruption to your business.
